w8rules_editor_error_hold: Type how long the condition must last: a number, 0 or more.
w8rules_editor_flag_nothing: This rule reads an on/off signal: there is no threshold to set. You can still choose how long it must last before you are told.
w8rules_editor_hold_anomaly_help: How long the anomaly must last before you are told. 0 tells you at once.
w8rules_editor_hold_help: How long the condition must hold before you are told. 0 tells you at the first check that sees it.
w8rules_editor_threshold_duration_help: An age or a delay: type it in the unit that suits you.
w8rules_overrides_flag: On/off rule: nothing to set per device, only whether it applies.
